svg.title: VERDICT: Game flows
svg.text: Red Flag Court and Jailbreak the Jury: where each step runs, where text is hidden, and the one path to a public record.
Quick Verdict, off-chain, no receipt, no appeals. The message never goes on-chain; an opt-in pattern record can (Sheet 8).
Tap any word to hide it.
All daily play runs in the practice court. Only opted-in, bench-caught finalists ever reach a public network (ADR-015).

Browser hides personal details before anything leaves the device.

Red Flag cards never show the message, the sender or anything redacted.
Caught cards show the trick as an ink bar (strikethrough only for public categories).
